validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real, current, independently confirmed. Gulf South Pipeline Company, LLC filed a section 7(b)/7(c) NGA application on 2025-01-28 for the Parks Line Upgrade and Sorrento Station (PLUSS) Project (FERC Docket CP25-54-000): replacement of ~4.5 mi (11 non-contiguous segments) of the existing 30-in Index 330 pipeline in St. Martin Parish, LA, plus a new 12,510-hp Sorrento Compressor Station on the existing 24-in Index 270 pipeline in Ascension Parish, LA, with two new 0.29-mi 30-in suction/discharge laterals and a new 1.06-mi 20-in delivery lateral -- restoring the pipeline's certificated 1,000-psi MAOP and adding 236,000 Dth/d of firm capacity. FERC issued the certificate 2025-12-02 (still authorized/pending construction as of the most recent disclosures found; no independent evidence of physical construction start). Corroborated by two independent origins: (1) FERC/Federal Register restating the applicant's filing -- https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/02/18/2025-02711/gulf-south-pipeline-company-llc-notice-of-application-and-establishing-intervention-deadline (application notice) and https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/09/10/2025-17406/gulf-south-pipeline-company-notice-of-availability-of-the-environmental-assessment-for-the-proposed (EA notice, states the 1,000-psi MAOP figure); (2) EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook, an independent federal compilation -- https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx (sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects', row 95) and the earlier https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx, tracking the same docket since 2025-07 (then 'Announced'), 'Approved' from 2026-01 on. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission-system reliability/capacity project (NGA-jurisdictional, high-pressure, compressor-station scope) -- not gathering/distribution, not misclassified. DUPLICATE: checked against the roster's Gulf South rows (P7784 Eunice/Lake Charles Supply, P7810 Kosci Junction, P7815 Southeast CURE) -- PLUSS is a distinct project (different scope, docket, and parishes); no overlap found. One collateral finding routed to P7784 in cross_row_leads (see below): the 'Eunice Reliability and Lake Charles Supply Project' page sits under Boardwalk's Texas Gas Transmission, LLC subsidiary path on gulfsouthpl.com, not the Gulf South Pipeline Company, LLC path -- worth checking P7784's Operator/Owner attribution. Opened/read to exhaustion: the FR application notice (sources Length/Diameter/Location/Capacity/SegmentCost/Operator at once) and the FR EA notice (sources Pressure/Status timeline). Wiki citation pool: opened the PLUSS-specific citation (bwpipelines.com/.../pluss-project/default.aspx, now 404) plus ~8 of the ~31 harvested citations that plausibly bore on this row (Loews investor-relations page, SEC Boardwalk prospectus/10-Q, FERC CP15-517 order); the remainder are historical Gulf South expansions (Willis Lateral, Coastal Bend Header, Index 99, East Texas-to-Mississippi, Lamar County) unrelated to PLUSS and not opened further.

validity.researcher_notes: The FERC application notice (2025-02711) itemizes the PLUSS Project's NEW pipe precisely: two 30-in suction/discharge laterals at the Sorrento Compressor Station, each ~0.29 mi (0.58 mi total), plus a ~1.06-mi 20-in delivery lateral -- 1.64 mi of new pipe in two diameters. That is distinct from the ~4.5 mi of EXISTING 30-in Index 330 pipeline being replaced in-kind (same corridor, not new route-miles). EIA's own 'miles' field for this project (1.65, consistent 2025-07 through 2026-08 releases) and its 'pipeline_diameter_inches' field (from 2026-01 on: '30, 20') independently match the FERC filing's new-pipe arithmetic almost exactly. The sheet's recorded LengthKnown=2.00/Diameter=30 (single value) is ~21% off on length and omits the 20-in delivery lateral -- a material disagreement, not within-rounding agreement. Two independent origins agree with each other (FERC/Federal Register restating the applicant's filing; EIA's independent compilation) against the sheet's current single-diameter/rounded-length figure. Diameter and Length fills below carry the corrected values with these two refs; the current sheet values are the disputed figures named in `contested`.
